name: Mossgrove 7: Save Changes
description: Quote to cash (project 11): writes a plan to Google Sheets (quotes, events, payments, schedule) and sends emails (Gmail live, Outbox tab in test).

parameters.content:
## Mossgrove 7: Save Changes
Every other workflow decides what should happen in code (a **plan**) and hands it here. **Build Batch** turns the plan into one Google Sheets request: new quotes, history, payments, bookings and (in test mode) emails are appended to their tabs, and changed quote fields are written cell by cell. One request means the whole change is saved or none of it is, in about a second; values are written as text or numbers, never formulas. In live mode emails go out with Gmail, with the quote, invoice or receipt PDF attached. **Result** runs last and is what the caller gets back.
